text:
liz: Heads up — releasebot queued v1.12.3 but the PR landed is docs-only. Do we still bump the patch for stable? @omar

omar: we keep going back and forth. historically we always bump numeric patch on stable releases. docs-only used to be buildmeta-only in early workflows.

deploy-bot: releasebot: queued v1.12.3+build.456 -> stable (canary start)

sam: playbook check — if canary fails we auto-rollback to previous tag, yes.

maggie: if we skip patch, our release-notes automation often skips the change unless we wire buildmeta into the changelog pipeline. currently that pipeline only looks for semver increments.

kevin: concrete proposal: add a "docs-only" label that causes releasebot to publish a buildmeta-only artifact (e.g. v1.12.2+docs.1) and NOT bump the patch. Only bump when code/api changes land.

omar: downside: customers pinning major.minor.patch will ignore buildmeta-only updates — which is intended for tiny doc fixes. but might surprise some teams.

liz: enterprise customers sometimes expect every public release to increment patch for telemetry. I'm fine with docs staying buildmeta-only, but we should communicate the behavior.

maggie: we can update the changelog generator to include buildmeta-only releases under a "docs" category so nothing gets lost.

deploy-bot: canary report: 3/5 OK, 2/5 FAILED (inference-tests timeouts). Rolling back to v1.12.2 now.

sam: rollback completed, created tag v1.12.2-rollback. Root cause looks infra flakiness, not related to the docs PR.

kevin: given the rollback, I'd still like the docs-only RFC. This incident shows we need clearer labels + releasebot tests but not a policy revert.

liz: action items: Omar + Kevin write RFC for "docs-only buildmeta" (policy + releasebot change). Maggie to add changelog inclusion. Sam add a short note to playbook about rollback tags naming (e.g., vX.Y.Z-rollback-<ts>).

omar: I'll draft the RFC this afternoon and link it here. @maggie can you add a releasebot flag prototype?

maggie: :thumbsup: will add the flag and unit tests so stable channel honors the docs-only label. Also add an integration test that release-notes picks up buildmeta entries.

liz: Thanks — ping me when RFC is up. If anyone needs a quick sync, grab 15 with me.

```example
# example tag for docs-only flow
git tag v1.12.2+docs.1 -m "docs-only release"
git push origin v1.12.2+docs.1
```

liz: closing thread for now — will reopen when RFC PR is ready. :white_check_mark:
